notes.title: 19.11.08 Thanks for 5000 copies! Sasuki Rin as Promised. and loads of updates
notes.content:
[h1]Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*]New playable character, Rin Satsuki, and a storyline exclusive to her——"Another Story". Required to be unlocked by finishing the story mode.
[*]Three new endings for Rin Satsuki (End.07, End.08, End.09). The game now contains 9 endings.
[*]Challenge Mode added. A leaderboard is present for challenge mode players. The mode is divided in four difficulties, Easy, Normal, Hard, and Lunatic. All three playable characters are available in this mode. However, save & load is disabled. The final score will be recored and go into the leaderboard.
[*]Bosses are now given more tracks, instead of sharing one boss fight theme. All bosses having their own leitmotifs in the original will have their sole tracks, none for those characters having no themes like Daiyousei and Koakuma.
[*]New defeated portraits for bosses, shown during the dialog after defeated a boss. If you get through the last spell with no hit, there are new portraits showing bosses receiving even more serious damage.
[*]Time limit is introduced in challenge mode, including stage time limit, and spell card time limit. When stage time is expired, random explosions will occur that hurt both you and enemy. When spell card time is expired during a boss fight, the boss will switch to the next spell card.
[*]Bosses now have extra attacks in Hard and Lunatic.
[*]A beta version of achievement system is introduced for testing. Currently there is only one achievement, try if you can find it!
[/list]

[h1]Adjustments[/h1]
[list]
[*]Different difficulties now have different enemy layouts, boss healthes, amounts of spell cards, and spell card performances.
[*]In challenge mode, dialogs will now be automatically skipped.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Optimized some gamepads that were not well-supported. (We haven't tested as many types of gamepad as expected yet, if your controller still have an issue, please contact me in my QQ group, the number is 2573802958)
[*]Fixed when background music is accidentally paused if not totally stopped playing.
[*]Fixed a great amount of other hard-to-describe issues.
[/list]

Hope you enjoy.

notes.title: 2019.10.18 Main Updates
notes.content:

- Keyboard & Mouse control and gamepad are now available. However, custom key config is currently not applied to gamepad. 
- Elite version of maid fairy now appears. 
- Altered the visual effect of upgrading, added visual effect for hitting enemies, and sound effect for shooting. 
- When your power reaches max, P point is no longer looted, instead, EXP point replaces it.

notes.title: 19.10.12 Main Update
notes.content:
# Main Updates

- Save & Load is now available. You can save when completed a stage. There are 12 available slots. After loaded a slot, the game starts at the beginning of the next stage.

- A minimap now appears on the top right, replacing the old map. Toggled in the ESC menu.

- When your character reaches the bottom of the screen, the item slot become translucent.

- A new power bar displays besides the health bar during the boss battle

- In sake of balance, Marisa's initial health is reset from 100HP to 60HP.

- Replace the sound played when hit.

notes.title: 19.10.07 Main Update
notes.content:
# Main Updates
- Fixed where the exit confirm menu overlaps the pause menu.
- Further fixed the hitbox glitch occured in stage 5.
- Giant Kedama and Dark Kedama now have two attacks.
- Replace Dark Kedamas in all maps.
- Fixed the hitbox of the doors in the library. Entering the boss room without destroying all the Philosopher's Stones is no longer allowed.
- Lil' Fairy now have a sound effect for her attack.
- Fixed the position of Flan · Patchouli's lasers during her last spell.

## Adjustment
- Most spell casting animation of bosses are now affected by time stop.
- The hitboxs of many enemy's bullets are now decreased by 15%~20%
- Adjusted key config is now only applied during the game. In the title screen though, default config is applied.

notes.title: 19.10.05 Main Update
notes.content:
- Fixed ESC-pausing, mainly including:
 Pressing ESC in the telpher ejects the player and stuck the game.
 Pressing ESC during a boss fight causes various glitches.
- You may now skip cutscenes by pressing LCtrl.

Gamepad support coming soon, please wait warmly.
